verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage is a SaaS compliance platform that ships AI agents for screening and transaction monitoring, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no documentation of a setting, contractual term, or policy that stops customer data from being used to train AI models. The cited items cover screening, cases, exports, webhooks and agentic workflows, none of which address training-data use.
